data.name: Emiline
data.short_meaning: Emma + Linda, devoted to the Lindens
data.long_meaning: The name Emiline is derived from the Latin name Aemiliana, which is composed of the elements ‘Aemilius’ and ‘ana’ (meaning ‘on’ or ‘resembling’). The root ‘Aemilius’ is believed to be derived from ‘e-militare’ – to be eager in a military campaign. The name Emiline was popularized during the Middle Ages and the Renaissance in Europe. The name is also associated with the Linden tree, which symbolizes peace, protection, and rebirth.
